history.p: The cantata was written on the occasion of Musikforeningen's 50th anniversary. Hartmann was chairman and his son-in-law, Niels W. Gade, the conductor of Musikforeningen.

Page 42 blank. A separate bifolio with "Indlæg Litr. A and C-E". Sketches for Nos. 1, 2, 4 and 5 in purple ink and pencil on four more bifolios.

physDesc.physMedium: In cloth half binding with marbled sides. Handwritten label pasted on front cover inscribed: "Tonernes Verden. / I.P.E. Hartmann Partitur" in foreign hand. Written in brown and purple ink. Paper: 20 staves; p. 1: 18 staves. Orchestral parts in Hartmann's hand, choral parts and text in foreign hand. On p. 35 a correction sheet (17.5 x 12.5 cm) has been glued into the score. On p. 60 the last two bars have been cancelled, and between pp. 60 and 61 a sheet in Niels W. Gade's hand paginated 60 (b) 61 (a) has been added; On pp. 63-67 the orchestral parts have been written in the same hand as the choral parts, apart from some minor addition in purple ink in Hartmann's hand. Later emendations in pencil.

physDesc.physMedium: Bound in cardboard with leather spine and marbled sides. In lower left-hand corner of the cover label inscribed: "'Musikforeningens Archiv'.1083.
